text:
zoe: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight "signal-reconciler" between probes and policy to reduce route churn.

kartik: curious - how is this different from the gate idea?

zoe: reconciler focuses on multi-signal merging + explicit hysteresis. outputs reconciled_context + stability_score. minimal DSL change.

emily: inputs/outputs?

zoe: inputs: latency, capacity, price, tenant-overrides. outputs: {latency_ms, capacity_pct, stability, sticky_flag, reason_tag} (we'll emit as one string blob in traces).

kartik: perf concerns?

zoe: target in-process p95 <1ms. fallback sidecar if not achievable. algorithm: short median filter + EWMA + hysteresis counters + cooldown window.

emily: rollout plan?

zoe: phase0 dark-run (telemetry-only 72h), phase1 1% canary with soft-prefer raw when stability<0.5, stepwise ramp.

kartik: telemetry names?

zoe: reconciler.event.{region}.{signal}.{result}, reconciler.confidence.{signal}, reconciler.replay_id on snapshots. include flip_count and cooldown_ms.

qa-bot: tests: spike injection, fuzzed probe traces, tenant-override conflicts. add replay endpoint to re-run eval with raw vs reconciled using replay_id.

devops-bot: dark-run scheduled -> job=rr-1799912345-1 regions=[us-east-1,us-west-2]

zoe: ownership: I'll prototype reconciler core, Emily owners adapters, Kartik updates compiler. PR will include short compatibility shim (route.use_reconciled_context optional). Review by Wed? :thumbsup:

kartik: ack. will prep compiler changes.

emily: will add adapters + tests.

zoe: closing thread for now; will post RFC follow-up link when PR is up: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/reconciler (draft).
